name: Sourcegraph MCP
description: Searches code, jumps to definitions and references, and reads files and commit history across your Sourcegraph instance's repositories, for coding agents on Enterprise plans.

skills.name: Code Search
skills.description: Searches code across repositories by exact keyword or natural language, with repo, file, and revision filters.

skills.name: Go to Definition and References
skills.description: Finds a symbol's definition from a usage and lists every reference to it, across repositories with compiler-level accuracy.

skills.name: Commit and Diff Search
skills.description: Searches commit messages, authors, and code changes across repositories, and compares two revisions file by file.

skills.name: Read Repository Files
skills.description: Reads file contents by line range and revision, lists directories, and finds repositories, branches, and tags by name.

skills.name: Deep Search
skills.description: Answers complex codebase questions through Deep Search conversations and reads past Deep Search results back as context.
